description_en: Queries whether a database account of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster is associated with a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 检查当前调用接口的RAM用户，是否已绑定集群数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun adb check-bind-ram-user --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-wz9842849v60000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckBindRamUser

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

Result.description_en:
The returned result of the request. Valid values:

true: the database account is associated with a RAM user.
false: the database account is not associated with a RAM user
Result.description_zh:
任务返回结果。取值说明：
true：当前RAM用户已绑定数据库账号。
false：当前RAM用户未绑定数据库账号
